segments.sn23.34:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.34:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
segments.sn23.34:2.1: “Yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn23.34:2.3: Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … vedanā nirodhadhammo;
segments.sn23.34:2.4: tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … saññā nirodhadhammo;
segments.sn23.34:2.5: tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … saṅkhārā nirodhadhammo;
segments.sn23.34:2.6: tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … viññāṇaṃ nirodhadhammo;
segments.sn23.34:2.7: tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo;
segments.sn23.34:2.8: tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti [sīhaḷapotthake pana imasmiṃ vagge chattiṃsa suttāni vibhattāni ekekaṃ suttaṃ tīṇi tīṇi katvā, evaṃ catutthavaggepi].
segments.sn23.34:3.1: Māro ca māradhammo ca, aniccena apare duve;
segments.sn23.34:3.3: Dukkhena ca duve vuttā, anattena tatheva ca;
